channel.title: Honolulu Civil Beat - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Honolulu Civil Beat (civilbeat.org)

item.title: ICE Concerns Spur Maui’s Move To Sever Ties With Feds
item.description: Worried about immigration actions across the nation, the Maui County Council voids longtime local partnership between its police and the FBI.

item.title: Neal Milner: ‘Corruptomania’ Is A Dangerous Thing
item.description: Being quick to blame major public policy failures on corruption hides the fact that it's most often incompetence that's causing our problems, not ethical wrongdoing.

item.title: That Purple Hawai‘i Vacation Lei Likely Came From Thailand. Lawmakers Want To Change That
item.description: Locals prefer local flowers, but imported flowers help stretch limited local supplies.

item.title: Primary Care Must Be Protected As Hawaiʻi’s Health System Evolves
item.description: If we are serious about long-term health care cost control and outcomes, we must shift more resources to primary care.

item.title: Here Comes The Judge? Not So Fast, Says State’s Appellate Court
item.description: The Senate wants to add a seventh position to the ICA. Court officials say it’s not needed.

item.title: Word Row: March 12
item.description: Like Wordle, only harder. Six letters in this one.

item.title: Kaua‘i’s Robinson Family Seeks To Evict Major Hawaiʻi Farm
item.description: Gay & Robinson has filed a lawsuit demanding nearly $700,000 in unpaid rent from Aloun Farms.

item.title: ʻO Haleakalā Anei Kahi E Kū Mai Ai He Kūʻē Hou ʻAna I Ka ʻOhe Nānā?
item.description: Aia ke kūʻē ikaika ʻia nei nā mea e hoʻolālā ʻia nei no kekahi mau ʻohe nānā pūʻalikoa hou ma luna o ke kuahiwi. ʻAʻole nō naʻe i like ka nui o ke kūʻē ʻia o nā papahana kūkulu ʻohe nānā ʻē aʻe o Maui ma nā makahiki i hala me ke aukahi kūʻē i ka TMT ma Hawaiʻi Mokupuni.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Storm Shutters Schools, State Offices As Weather Expected To Worsen
item.description: Gov. Josh Green issued an emergency order as winds and flooding from a Kona low storm threaten major population centers.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Storm Update: Forecast, Schools, Closures, Shelters, More
item.description: Latest news from officials on the Kona low storm passing over Hawaiʻi amid concerns of flooding and high winds.
